tactics:
induction l generalizing l' i with
  | nil => simp at h
  | cons a as ih =>
    cases l' with
    | nil => simp at h
    | cons b bs =>
      cases i with
      | zero => rfl
      | succ j => exact ih bs j (by simp at h ⊢; omega)
induction l generalizing l' i <;> cases l' <;> cases i <;> simp_all [List.zipWith_cons_cons]

induction l generalizing l' i with
  | nil => simp at h
  | cons a as ih =>
    cases l' with
    | nil => simp at h
    | cons b bs =>
      cases i with
      | zero => simp
      | succ j => simp only [List.zipWith_cons_cons, List.getElem_cons_succ]; exact ih _ _ _
